sources.name: Apple XNU boot session UUID
sources.fact: SYSCTL_STRING(_kern, bootsessionuuid) is CTLFLAG_RD; this is boot session identity, not APFS boot volume UUID. The code will fail if the running kernel does not expose it.

sources.name: Apple XNU model
sources.fact: hw.model is a read-only string serviced by HW_MODEL; no IOPlatformUUID or hardware serial is requested.

sources.name: Linux DMI public product name
sources.fact: product_name is mode0444 while product_serial is0400. The proposal reads only product_name at the fixed virtual-device path; no serial/UUID fallback.

sources.name: Linux boot identity
sources.fact: boot_id is the current boot's UUID; it differs from the separately exposed uuid entry that changes each read. Only boot_id is read.

sources.name: systemd machine-id semantics and privacy
sources.fact: /etc/machine-id is a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal installation/boot identity, not a hardware serial. Raw ID stays local; an application-specific keyed HMAC-SHA256 is emitted. A machine-ID match is not hardware attestation.
